name: Nissan Silvia (S15)
h1: Nissan Silvia S15: specs, SR20DET engine and what owners say

us.x: Never sold new in the US. Nissan sold the S15 new in Japan, Australia and New Zealand (as the 200SX there) and Indonesia; US cars are grey imports. Each car becomes legal to import under the 25-year rule once it is 25 years old by its month of build. S15s were built from January 1999 to August 2002, so the first ones qualified in January 2024 and the last ones qualify in 2027.

fame.x: The S15 is the most successful car in Japan’s D1 Grand Prix drift series. Wikipedia’s list of champions shows S15 drivers winning 12 titles from 2001 to 2022, including the very first, with 8 different drivers.

fame.t: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
fame.x: Han lends Sean his S15, and Sean wrecks it in his first race against Takashi. Its engine and parts then go into the Mustang for the final race, and Sean ends the film in an S15 Spec-R. Top Gear Netherlands calls the film car the “Mona Lisa” of the drift world.
Nissan stopped building the S platform in August 2002, as it cut down its many platforms. The S15 was the final Silvia.
S15 Silvia Spec-Rs show up in Initial D, driven by Hiroya Okuyama and by the “Two Guys From Tokyo”.

related.t: Nissan 240SX S14 (the US car before it)

gens.tag: 2.0-liter SR20DET turbo inline-4, 250 PS (247 hp), 6-speed, rear-drive. Japan, Australia and New Zealand.

variants.name: Silvia Spec-S

tq.note: lb-ft at 4,800 rpm (192 Nm, 19.6 kgm; converted from Nm, JDM)

trans.note: open differential; a viscous limited-slip was optional

variants.what: The base car, with the non-turbo SR20DE.

variants.name: Silvia Spec-R
variants.what: The turbo car: the SR20DET with a ball-bearing turbo, a 6-speed manual and a helical limited-slip differential. An Aero version added a big rear wing, side skirts and new bumpers.

variants.name: Silvia Varietta
variants.what: A convertible with a folding hardtop, built by Autech on the Spec-S with the non-turbo engine. Only 1,143 were built.

SR20DET.name: Nissan SR20DET
facts: Inline-4, DOHC 16-valve, aluminum block with steel sleeves, aluminum head, timing chain
250 PS (247 hp) at 6,400 rpm, 275 Nm (203 lb-ft) at 4,800 rpm in the S15 Spec-R
One turbo; the S15 got a ball-bearing unit, which lifted output to 250 PS
Silvia from the S13 in 1991 to the S15 in 2002

issues.t: Camshaft wear from skipped oil changes
issues.x: Auto Express says the SR20DET can wear its camshafts fast when oil changes have been skipped. CarsGuide says to look under the oil filler cap for sludge, and to check that the oil on the dipstick is clean.
Auto Express says a rattle on start-up can mean the variable valve timing system is worn. It wrote this about the S14 200SX, which used the same SR20DET.

issues.t: Turbo gasket and exhaust manifold leaks
issues.x: Auto Express says blown turbo gaskets are common and make the car very noisy at idle, and that exhaust manifolds are a weak point that can leak.

Retro Rides says white exhaust smoke means the turbo is burning oil. Auto Express adds that many of these turbos are now old, and CarsGuide warns that owners often fit bigger turbos and new electronics, so take care with modified cars.

SR20DE.name: Nissan SR20DE
facts: Inline-4, DOHC 16-valve, aluminum block and head, timing chain
165 PS (163 hp) at 6,400 rpm, 192 Nm (142 lb-ft) at 4,800 rpm in the S15 Spec-S
